page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. The CPU configuration lacks advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA_NI). It also lacks virtualization extensions and hyper-threading capabilities.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for entry-level applications, lightweight web serving, development environments, and basic database hosting that do not require specialized hardware acceleration, local NVMe storage, or advanced vector processing instructions.
